name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_clostridioides_difficile_infection_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of Clostridioides difficile infection.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of Clostridioides difficile infection.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of Clostridioides difficile infection.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of Clostridioides difficile infection.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_clostridioides_difficile_infection_now@@diagnosed_according_to_icd10_code_a07
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the diagnosis of Clostridioides difficile infection is made according to ICD-10 code A07.
when_true: Set to true if the diagnosis of Clostridioides difficile infection is made according to ICD-10 code A07.
when_false: Set to false if the diagnosis of Clostridioides difficile infection is not made according to ICD-10 code A07.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the diagnosis of Clostridioides difficile infection is made according to ICD-10 code A07.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_finding_of_insufficient_clinical_detail_given_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has insufficient clinical detail given (incomplete medical data).
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has insufficient clinical detail given (i.e., incomplete medical data).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have insufficient clinical detail given (i.e., medical data is complete).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has insufficient clinical detail given.
